case.title: The Vanishing Guest
case.introduction: A gala ends. One guest is gone. No body is found.
case.crime: A guest vanished after the gala. He left no trace.
case.escape_plan: He will use the service elevator at midnight. He has a hidden keycard for the back door.

rooms.name: Lobby
rooms.description: A bright hall with a big desk.

rooms.name: Suite 101
rooms.description: A fancy room with a balcony.

rooms.name: Kitchen
rooms.description: A busy place with many pots.

characters.name: Anna Lee
lies: She said she was in the lobby at 9 PM.

characters.name: Mark Daniels
lies: He said he saw no one in the corridor at 9:30 PM.

characters.name: Sofia Martinez
characters.secret: She uses a fake name to hide past fraud.
characters.habits: Smooths her hair when she talks.
lies: She said she arrived at 7 PM.

characters.name: Elliot Gray
characters.secret: They are a private detective hired by a rival hotel.
lies: They said they left early at 10 PM.

timeline.description: Guest named Mr. Julian Hart is missing.
Service elevator opens for staff only.

evidence.name: Keycard swipe log
evidence.description: Shows a swipe at 12:02 AM from suite to service elevator.

evidence.name: Fake passport
evidence.description: Has name Mr. Julian Hart but photo of Sofia.

evidence.name: Broken vase
evidence.description: Found in lobby with glass shards.

evidence.name: Spice bag label
evidence.description: Shows rare spice missing from kitchen inventory.

hidden_clues: A note with the name Julian Hart was found in Suite 101.
red_herrings: A loud crash was heard from the kitchen at 9:45 PM.

solution.target_true_identity: Sofia Martinez is actually Julian Hart, a jewel thief.
solution.reasoning: Keycard log shows she used the service elevator after midnight. The fake passport matches the name Julian Hart. The hidden note links the name to the suite. Lies about arrival time hide her plan.

state.current_objective: Find out which guest is not who they say they are.
